children: SAYS GIVEN HOW THE MIDDLE EAST SITUATION HAS BEEN UNFOLDING, AND HOW DEMAND HAS RESPONDED TO HIGHER PRICES SO FAR RISKS TO IT'S OIL PRICE FORECASTS ARE SKEWED HIGHER
SAYS OIL PRICES COULD POTENTIALLY RISE ANOTHER 50% FROM CURRENT LEVELS BEFORE MARKETS REACH AN ORGANIC BALANCE IF CURRENT SITUATION PERSISTS
SAYS INVENTORY AND DEMAND INDICATORS SHOW PRICES HAVE A LONG WAY TO GO BEFORE SUPPLY AND DEMAND CONVERGE
SAYS NON-OPEC SUPPLY RESPONSE HAS BEEN VERY INCREMENTAL SO FAR BUT IT COULD CHANGE IN COMING MONTHS DUE TO LAGS AND PRODUCTION GROWTH HAS NOT BEEN HUGELY SURPRISING TO THE UPSIDE, OUTSIDE OF BRAZIL
